Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic and Metal. Colour: Green. Stated size: 180 cm. Product weight: 6.5 kg. Specification: 8 lighting modes. Quantity: 1 piece.
Features 8 distinct lighting modes to create various festive atmospheres.
Stands 180 cm tall, providing a substantial and eye-catching holiday display.
Constructed from durable plastic and metal for long-lasting seasonal use.
Warm white illumination adds a soft, inviting glow to your Christmas decor.

5059442204571.sourceDescription:
With its classic Christmas-tree shape and naturally dense growth, a pot-grown Fraser Fir makes a traditional choice for the festive season while offering something extra beyond December. The rich green foliage forms neat layers of branches that are easy to decorate, while the short, soft needles and good needle retention help it remain an attractive feature throughout the celebrations. This real Christmas tree has also been grown in a pot from the outset, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container before sale.
CLASSIC CHRISTMAS CHARACTER: Naturally conical and densely branched, Fraser Fir has the traditional Christmas-tree shape many people look for, with rich green foliage that creates a full appearance without needing excessive decoration. The branches provide plenty of room for lights, baubles, and other festive favourites.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
SOFT NEEDLES, LASTING DISPLAY: Fraser Fir has relatively soft needles that are pleasant to handle when decorating, while its needle retention helps it maintain a full appearance throughout the festive period. The foliage also releases a fresh, characteristic fir fragrance, adding another familiar part of the real Christmas tree experience.
FROM CHRISTMAS TREE TO GARDEN TREE: Once Christmas is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue caring for it as it grows. Fraser Firs are excellent evergreen trees for garden, bringing year-round foliage and structure rather than having its role end when the decorations come down.
ENJOY IT AGAIN IN YEARS TO COME: Caring for a pot-grown tree between Christmases gives it the opportunity to return to your home for future celebrations. Keep it growing outdoors during the rest of the year, and this potted real Christmas tree can become a Christmas tradition that grows with you, rather than a tree bought and replaced each season.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

0810203490771.sourceDescription: Add a sweet, elegant twist to your tree with the Sleetly 12-pack white glitter heart Christmas ornaments. The frosty white finish matches our white snowball bauble ornaments perfectly, so you can mix shapes for a cohesive, layered all-white tree with extra character. The timeless white palette suits farmhouse, modern, romantic, and classic winter themes, and looks striking in monochrome white or mixed with silver, gold, and colored accents. Their charm reaches well beyond the Christmas tree, too: these white hearts are ideal for Valentine's Day displays, weddings, bridal showers, engagement parties, and anniversary decor, making them a versatile, reusable accent you will enjoy all year long. At 3.15 inches, they are sized for any standard 5-to-8-foot tree and look lovely tucked among rounder ornaments or clustered on a garland. Made from durable shatterproof plastic, these ornaments resist the cracking and breaking that can happen with real glass, making them a smart choice for homes with pets or high-traffic spaces, and easy to store and reuse year after year. They are also lightweight, so they hang without weighing branches down. Each heart comes with a pre-attached white ribbon hanger finished with a decorative metal cap, so you can skip the hooks and decorate right away. Pair them with our white snowball, swirl, and finial ornaments to complete an elegant all-white collection throughout your home.

5056141024271.sourceDescription:
Bring a warm, traditional feel to festive gifting with these large vintage hessian Christmas stocking sacks. Made from natural threads and finished with a high quality black and red print on fine hessian fabric, they offer a rustic look with plenty of seasonal charm. The brown design is ideal for creating a coordinated presentation under the tree or by the fireplace, while the generous sack size gives you ample space for gifts, treats and surprises. Each sack measures 70 x 50 cm, making it a practical choice for larger presents as well as smaller festive items. Supplied in two designs, this set adds variety without losing the classic look, helping you create an inviting Christmas display that feels thoughtful and memorable. A simple yet stylish way to present gifts on Christmas morning, these hessian sacks suit family celebrations and decorative seasonal styling alike.
Made from natural threads with fine hessian fabric for a rustic festive finish that feels traditional and decorative.
High quality black and red print adds contrast and gives each sack a classic vintage Christmas character.
Each sack measures 70 x 50 cm, offering generous space for gifts, treats and seasonal surprises.
Supplied in two designs to add variety while keeping the overall look coordinated and full of old world charm.
A practical and charming way to present Christmas morning gifts for children, family and festive displays.

9798173634771.sourceDescription: **40PCS Assorted Christmas Ornament Set**: Includes 40 festive pieces in total: 6cm large baubles, 3cm, 5cm mini baubles and decorative pendants in house, heart and pinecone shapes. Combines timeless festive appeal with reliable shatter resistance, making them safe and long-lasting for family households. **Mixed Sizes & Shapes for Layered Styling**: Comes in two bauble sizes plus decorative shaped pendants. Perfect for filling gaps between branches and creating eye-catching focal points, suitable for all sizes of real and artificial Christmas trees. **Easy to Hang with Pre-Attached Strings**: Each bauble and pendant comes with a pre-fixed hanging cap and string, ready to use straight out of the gift box. Lightweight construction sits securely on branches without weighing down delicate foliage. **Versatile Reusable Festive Decorations**: Ideal for decorating Christmas trees, garlands, wreaths, windows and mantelpieces. Suitable for home decor, holiday parties and seasonal retail displays. Durable and easy to store for repeated use year after year.

8956086439871.sourceDescription:
A 122 cm black velvet tree skirt with a pleated ruffle edge and a tie closure. Large enough to sit under a 6 to 7 ft tree and still leave room for presents around it.

The velvet has a soft finish and falls in folds rather than standing stiff, and the ruffled border gives it weight at the hem. A centre opening with ties means you can wrap it round the stand and knot it at the back. Black is the modern choice: it makes gold, silver and white decorations look sharper and it does not compete with a patterned rug. Spot clean or hand wash cold, then dry flat.

Sizing: 90 cm suits 4 to 5 ft trees, 122 cm suits 6 to 7 ft, 150 cm suits 7.5 to 9 ft.

8956086258571.sourceDescription:
These white stainless steel towel hooks give a bathroom, kitchen or bedroom a clean modern line without taking up floor space. The set contains three hooks, enough for a matching row beside a basin, behind a door or along a kitchen wall.

Each hook is made from premium stainless steel with a white finish and measures 10 x 6 x 5 cm (3.93 x 2.36 x 1.97 in). The material is hard wearing and suited to damp rooms such as bathrooms and utility areas, and the heavy duty build holds towels, dressing gowns, coats and hats steadily without bending under the weight.

The shape is smooth and rounded with no sharp edges, so fabrics are not pulled or marked. Fitting to a flat, smooth wall is straightforward, and once in place the hook stays firm rather than working loose, so it is a reliable choice for a busy household where things are taken down and hung up all day.

Use them for hand towels and bath towels in the bathroom, for cooking tools and aprons in the kitchen, and for umbrellas, keys, bags and clothes in the hallway, and the understated design sits easily with most styles of home decor. They also suit hotels, guest rooms and utility areas where regular, dependable hanging space is needed
Guarantee - 1 month

8941467526271.baseName: Christmas Fridge Door Handle Covers 6 Pack Santa Snowman Kitchen Appliance Handle Cover Holiday Decorations Indoor
8941467526271.variantName: Christmas Fridge Door Handle Covers 6 Pack Santa Snowman Kitchen Appliance Handle Cover Holiday Decorations Indoor
8941467526271.sourceDescription:
This six piece set dresses up the handles of a fridge, oven, microwave or dishwasher for Christmas. It contains four long covers and two short covers, enough for a two door fridge or a mix of appliances around the kitchen.

Both sizes are made from hessian with a double layer lining, which gives them enough body to hold their shape while staying soft to the touch. The long covers measure 15.7 x 2.1 in (15.7 x 5.1 in when expanded) and the short covers measure 7.8 x 2 in (7.8 x 5.1 in when expanded), so they fit standard bar handles on fridges, microwaves, ovens, kitchen cabinets and dishwashers.

A strip of self adhesive tape runs from top to bottom on each cover. Wrap it around the handle, press the tape down and the cover stays in place; peel it away when you want to clean it or store it. No tools and no drilling are needed, and the fabric keeps handles away from stains, water marks, fingerprints and sticky hands, which is useful in a busy kitchen over the holidays.

The covers wipe clean easily and can be reused, so they save time on cleaning and go back on the appliances the following December. Snowman, Santa Claus and reindeer motifs in dark wine red give the kitchen a festive look, and all six pieces share the same tone so a fridge, oven and dishwasher read as one scheme rather than a mix of odd covers. The set is light, folds flat for storage and makes a practical gift for family and friends.

Bring the classic colours of Christmas into your home with this light up poinsettia from MySmartBuy. Rich red blooms with a soft, velvety look sit above deep green leaves, and 10 warm white LEDs nestle at the centre of the flowers, giving a gentle glow that makes them look beautifully lit from within. The plant is presented in a shiny gold pot that adds a touch of festive luxury and sits perfectly alongside gold, red and green decorations. Unlike a real poinsettia, it needs no watering, will not drop its leaves and can be enjoyed throughout the festive season and brought out again year after year. Measuring 35 x 28 x 28cm, it is a lovely size for dining tables, sideboards, windowsills, hallway tables and mantelpieces. It is battery operated, so there are no trailing cables and you can place it wherever you like, even away from a socket. It runs on 2 x AA batteries, which are not included. A long-lasting alternative to a real plant, and a lovely Christmas gift for friends, family, neighbours and teachers. 3622392484571.sourceDescription:
1. Core Specifications
Size: 120cm in diameter. The extra-large round design fully covers the base of most standard to large Christmas trees, leaving ample space for arranging gifts, garlands, or small holiday decor around it.
Material: Premium plush fur. It features a soft, dense, and fluffy texture that mimics high-quality fur, delivering a luxurious touch underfoot and a visually rich look.
Dual Holiday Use: Tailored for both Christmas and New Year. Its versatile design complements Christmas tree themes and seamlessly transitions to New Year’s decor, maximizing its use across holiday seasons.
2. Festive & Practical Highlights
Tree Base Transformation: Hides unsightly plastic or metal tree stands completely, turning the area under your tree into a plush, elegant focal point. It pairs perfectly with garlands draped around the tree for a cohesive look.
Multi-functional as a Rug: Beyond a tree skirt, it works as a small fur rug. Place it near sofas, fireplaces, or entryways to add warmth and holiday charm to other areas of your home.
Atmosphere Enhancer: The plush fur texture adds a sense of luxury and coziness to your space. It softens hard floor surfaces and creates a welcoming vibe for family, friends, or guests during holiday events.
3. User-friendly Details
Easy to Install: Features a simple split design with hook-and-loop fasteners. Wrap it around the tree base, secure the fasteners, and it’s ready to use—no complex assembly required.
Durable & Reusable: High-quality plush material resists shedding and maintains its fluffiness. It can be folded flat for compact storage after holidays, ensuring it stays in great condition for years.
Easy to Clean: For light dirt or dust, gently shake or vacuum with a soft brush attachment. For small stains, wipe lightly with a damp cloth; air dry to preserve its texture.

Lilac garland × 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 pieces

PERFECT FOR CELEBRATION: This wreath beautifully transitions from a spring and summer wreath for front door to a festive fall wreath or holiday wreaths for Christmas and Thanksgiving, while also serving as charming wedding decor, farmhouse entryway accent, or year-round home decoration.
THOUGHTFUL GIFT READY TO GIVE: This wreath arrives in a presentation-ready package, making it the perfect surprise gift for housewarmings, Mother's Day, birthdays, or as a beauty to any friend or loved one's home.

5058194830571.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and wood, metal, and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Wood, Metal, and Plastic. Colour: Green. Stated size: 8 cm. Product weight: 1.2 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Features a convenient built-in timer function for automated operation.
Adorned with realistic pine cone details for an authentic festive look.
Crafted from durable wood, metal, and plastic materials.
Compact green wreath design perfect for Christmas door decoration.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and linen construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Plan the display

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

This Christmas rattan-style wreath is perfect for holiday decor, serving as a door wreath or a decorative accent. Its natural, rustic aesthetic complements farmhouse, country-style, and vintage-inspired holiday themes, adding a warm, festive atmosphere
 to homes, shops, storefronts, and event venues.
Ideal for a variety of holiday settings:
Front doors, back doors, and entryways
Walls, windows, and living rooms
Shop windows and store entrances
Holiday displays in shopping malls, cafés, and event spaces
Christmas parties and family gatherings
Hanging Instructions
When using it as a door wreath, secure it in place using appropriate hooks, cords, or fasteners, depending on the product's specific construction. For outdoor or entryway use, we recommend placing it in a sheltered area to help prolong its lifespan. Please
 check the product dimensions before ordering to ensure it fits your intended door, wall, or window space.
Styling Suggestions
This rattan wreath can be embellished with various Christmas elements—such as bows, pine branches, red berries, or string lights—depending on the product's design. It is an excellent choice for Christmas and winter holiday décor, and also makes a thoughtful
 holiday gift.

5056589110871.sourceDescription:
Create a warm and welcoming festive entrance with this 60cm Pre-Lit Plain Green Christmas Wreath with LEDs, a timeless decoration designed to bring natural charm and gentle illumination to your home. Whether displayed on your front door, above a fireplace, or as part of a larger seasonal arrangement, this beautifully crafted wreath adds a classic touch to your Christmas décor.

Featuring an impressive 160 tips, the wreath offers a full and realistic appearance. Its plain green design provides the perfect base for those who prefer a traditional style or wish to personalise it with ribbons, baubles, or other festive accents.

Lit with warm white LEDs, the wreath creates a cosy and inviting glow. It also includes a convenient timer function, automatically staying on for 8 hours and switching off for 16 hours. Battery operated and requiring 3 x AA batteries (not included), this wreath offers flexible placement without the need for nearby sockets or trailing wires.

With a generous 60cm diameter, it makes a striking statement while remaining versatile enough for a variety of indoor or outdoor settings.

Please note; the wreath will need the branches to be fluffed and rearranged to achieve the appearance in our product images.

Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use.

Warm White LEDs
External Diameter: 60cm Internal Diameter: 38cm
Requires 3 x AA Batteries
Timer Function 8 Hours on 16 Hours off
Lush & Natural Look: Designed with 160 dense tips to create a full-bodied wreath that closely replicates the appearance of real evergreen branches.
Cosy Warm White Illumination: Pre-lit with warm white LEDs that cast a soft, inviting glow, perfect for enhancing both daytime and evening displays.
Convenient Auto Timer: Built-in 8 hours on / 16 hours off timer function ensures effortless operation while conserving battery life throughout the season.
Multiple Lighting Effects: Choose from a variety of light settings to create anything from a gentle steady glow to more dynamic festive effects.
Flexible Battery Operation: Powered by 3 x AA batteries (not included), allowing easy placement on doors, walls, or fireplaces without the need for mains power.

Product Description

 This realistic Norfolk Pine Christmas garland is available in two sizes: 180cm (6FT) and 270cm (9FT). 
 It comes pre-equipped with a 5m 50 warm white LED light string powered by a 3-AA battery box (batteries NOT included). 
 Combined with Norfolk pine and cypress branches, total 180pcs lush foliage, it features a real-touch texture and flexible iron wire frame, which can be freely bent and shaped. 
 Decorative ornaments are not included, allowing you to DIY decorations as you like.

Product Specifications

 Sizes:270cm (9FT)

Product Overview

 Artificial snow‑flocked Christmas garland made of flame‑retardant PVC pine needles, decorated with pine cones and bright red berries. 
 Available in 1.8m(6ft) and 2.7m(9ft) lengths, two versions: pre‑lit with LED lights and unlit without lights. 
 The pre‑lit version comes with battery‑operated 3m warm‑white LED string lights (battery box, NO timer function, AA batteries not included). 
 Ideal for indoor & covered outdoor Christmas holiday decoration.

Common Specs for all variants

 Material: Flame‑retardant PVC pine branches, artificial pine cones, plastic red berries, snow flocking coating
 Style: Snow‑flocked frosted finish, classic Christmas decorative elements with pinecone & red berry ornaments
 Installation: Bendable branches, you can adjust and shape the garland freely to fit different scenes
 Application: Indoor and covered outdoor use

Version 1: Unlit Garland (No LED Lights)
Available lengths:

 1.8m / 6ft unlit garland
 2.7m / 9ft unlit garlandFeatures: Flexible bendable pine branches; you can add your own string lights as needed. Great for DIY holiday decor.

Application Scenarios

 Stair railings, banisters
 Fireplace mantel, hearth
 Front door frame, porch, window trim
 Archway, entryway, wall hanging
 Holiday party, shop window, café Christmas display
 Covered patio, covered outdoor eaves

Notes & Precautions

 For indoor and covered outdoor use only. Do not expose to heavy rain or standing water.
 Keep away from open flame and high‑temperature heat sources, even though the material is flame‑retardant.
REALISTIC SNOW-COVERED DESIGN: This Christmas wreath features lifelike snow-laden pine branches. The white “snow” complements the green needles beautifully, while natural-textured pine cones and vibrant red berries create an authentic winter wonderland scene. Instantly bringing the enchanting atmosphere of a Christmas forest into your home, it perfectly complements the festive spirit.
VERSATILE DECORATIVE USES:With dimensions suitable for various spaces (available in lengths of 1.8 metres / 70.87 inches, 2.7 metres / 106.3 inches, etc., and a width of 30 centimetres / 11.82 inches), this wreath is exceptionally practical. Hang it over your mantelpiece, drape it along banisters, adorn your fireplace surround, or use it to decorate doorways and windows. It integrates seamlessly into both indoor and sheltered outdoor Christmas displays, adding festive magic wherever it graces.
DURABLE AND REUSABLE:Crafted from premium materials, this garland is built to last. Its sturdy construction ensures it retains its shape and vibrant appearance year after year. Unlike real foliage, it won't shed needles and requires no maintenance, making it a convenient and enduring choice for Christmas decor that you can enjoy for many festive seasons to come.
EASY TO INSTALL AND STORE: Lightweight and flexible, the garland is effortless to hang. Secure it simply with hooks or cable ties, or lay it directly in place. After the festive season, it rolls or folds neatly, taking up minimal storage space for convenient preservation until next Christmas. This hassle-free storage and installation saves you time and effort.
IDEAL FOR CREATING FESTIVE AMBIENCE: Whether decorating for family gatherings, holiday parties, or simply wishing to immerse yourself in Christmas spirit, this garland is the perfect choice. The combination of snowflakes, pinecones, and berries evokes warmth, joy, and nostalgia, instantly transforming your space into a delightful festive haven.
Guarantee - 1 month

Light Up Reindeer
This light up reindeer brings a decorative light effect to your display. The white finish and polyester and aluminium construction give it a defined appearance for decorative lighting.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Light with a purpose
Place the light where its effect will be most useful within the intended setting. The position influences how the surrounding surfaces look, so consider nearby furniture, reflective finishes and the direction from which the light will be viewed.

Build a considered arrangement
Lighting can help define a particular part of a room or display. Combine the product with the lighting already present and adjust its position to create the balance you want, allowing practical room lighting and decorative accents to work together.

Make the most of the design
Give the light enough surrounding space for its shape and illumination to be appreciated. A clear position helps prevent neighbouring objects from obscuring the effect and makes the product easier to reach for ordinary operation or care.

Coordinate your decor
The listed finish can be paired with existing accessories or used as a contrasting detail. Lighting is both a functional and decorative part of an arrangement, so its appearance when switched off can also contribute to the overall setting.

Arrange before use
Set up the light according to its supplied instructions and choose a compatible power supply where required. Position any lead so that the installation remains orderly, and keep access available for switching the product off or disconnecting it.
